glosses: cube (a regular polyhedron having six identical square faces)
cube (the third power of a number, value, term or expression)

examples.text: El cubo estaba lleno de agua.
examples.en: The bucket was full of water.

examples.text: Casi no hay agua en el cubo.
examples.en: There's almost no water in the bucket.

examples.text: Este es un cubo de hielo.
